name: ferris-wheel-gallery
title: Ferris Wheel Gallery
description: A drawn Ferris wheel whose gondolas hold photo thumbnails. Choosing an item turns the wheel slot by slot with a springy settle and a gondola sway, while the large photo, a 'STUDY 03' label, title and discipline/year show beside it. Drag, scroll, arrow keys, click a gondola, or opt-in autoplay. Clean, editorial, shadcn-styled.
darkMode: fully shadcn tokens (background, foreground, card, muted, border, primary, ring, chart-2) - follows the theme
mainProps: items: {src, alt, title, id?, year?, discipline?}[], active/defaultActive/onActiveChange, direction ('cw' | 'ccw'), autoplay, interval (ms), plus any <div> props
notes: Requires Tailwind v4 (container queries @container / @min-[600px]/ferris:) and React 19 (ref as a prop). Uses the shadcn chart-2 colour for accents. Sizes itself to its container width (wheel + side panel above 600px, stacked below) - drop it in a max-w container. 6-10 items look best.
